definitions.explanation: Japanese theoretical physicist who predicted the meson in 1935. In 1949 he became the first Japanese Nobel laureate, winning the physics prize, which gave great encouragement to postwar Japan.

examples.japanese: {湯川秀樹|ゆかわひでき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝記|でんき}→伝記：04069_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a biography of Yukawa Hideki.

examples.japanese: {湯川秀樹|ゆかわひでき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中間子|ちゅうかんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予言|よげん}した→予言する：25500_yogensuru⟧。
examples.english: Yukawa Hideki predicted the existence of the meson.

examples.japanese: {湯川秀樹|ゆかわひでき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ノーベル{賞|しょう}→ノーベル賞：31186_nooberushou⟧⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Yukawa Hideki's Nobel Prize gave great hope to the Japanese after the war.

notes:
Often called {湯川博士|ゆかわはかせ} 'Dr. Yukawa'. He worked at Kyoto University, whose Yukawa Institute for Theoretical Physics is named after him, and after the war he campaigned against nuclear weapons.
